basic_info.description: This light and bright half floor 11th floor co-op apartment with terraces has stunning views from Alcatraz and the Golden Gate to the Bay Bridge and Sutro Tower. This exclusive 1929 Russian Hill Coop offers a full-time doorman & valet parking. Entering the apartment from the beautiful oval foyer with granite and steel inlaid floor opens to the expansive north side Bay views from the entertaining rooms.  The custom kitchen with family room has a convenient built-in office. Two south facing bedrooms include a primary with walk-in closet and marble bath with oaking tub and separate shower. The 2nd en-suite bedroom opens to a terrace overlooking the city. A full laundry room, storage (both in the unit and outside), doorman and easy parking (valet) makes this a perfect San Francisco home. Sold Furnished!
